general.title: Quick Guide For This Page
general.description: Use this guide to understand the current page and its most common workflow.
general.step1: Start with the page title and primary actions to understand the main purpose.
general.step2: Check filters or tabs before taking action so you are working with the right data.
general.step3: For advanced behavior, open the related settings section from the sidebar.

orders.title: Orders Guide
orders.description: Track orders, update statuses, and open order details from one place.
orders.step1: Use search and filters to find orders by status, customer, or date.
orders.step2: Open an order to review products, customer details, and shipping before changing status.
orders.step3: Update the status only after confirming readiness or the reason for a delay.
orders.step4: Use reports or printing when you need operational review or shipment preparation.

products.title: Products Guide
products.description: Add products and manage pricing, stock, variants, and images.
products.step1: Review the product name, price, and images because customers see these first.
products.step2: Set stock and variants such as size or color before activating the product.
products.step3: Use visibility and offer settings to improve the shopping and conversion experience.

customers.title: Customers Guide
customers.description: Manage customer profiles, communication history, and marketing segments.
customers.step1: Search by name or phone before creating a new record to avoid duplicates.
customers.step2: Open the customer profile to review orders, notes, and conversation history.
customers.step3: Use tags or segments to make follow-up and campaigns easier later.

inbox.title: Inbox Guide
inbox.description: Manage customer conversations, replies, and team handoffs.
inbox.step1: Start with open or unread conversations so customer replies are not delayed.
inbox.step2: Review customer and order context before sending a reply or creating an order.
inbox.step3: Use transfer or close when the conversation moves to another owner or follow-up ends.

dashboard.title: Dashboard Guide
dashboard.description: Review company performance, alerts, and daily shortcuts.
dashboard.step1: Check key metrics to understand orders, sales, and important alerts.
dashboard.step2: Use shortcuts to reach the workflows you use most often.
dashboard.step3: Use date ranges or filters when you need to compare performance.

categories.title: Categories Guide
categories.description: Organize products into clear storefront sections.
categories.step1: Use category names that customers can understand quickly.
categories.step2: Sort categories by sales priority or the most visited sections.
categories.step3: Attach products to the right category so filters and pages work correctly.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Guide
whatsapp.description: Manage WhatsApp connection, conversations, and related notifications.
whatsapp.step1: Confirm connection status before relying on replies or notifications.
whatsapp.step2: Review assignment and auto-reply settings so conversations reach the right person.
whatsapp.step3: Check alerts and logs when sending or receiving stops.

advertising.title: Advertising Guide
advertising.description: Track campaigns, settings, and ad performance from one place.
advertising.step1: Start by checking connected accounts and pixels before reading performance.
advertising.step2: Use filters to compare campaigns or ad sets by date range.
advertising.step3: Review profit and conversion metrics before increasing budget or changing campaigns.

affiliates.title: Affiliates Guide
affiliates.description: Manage affiliates, commissions, and attributed orders.
affiliates.step1: Review affiliate status before approving or disabling an account.
affiliates.step2: Track orders and commissions to understand each affiliate's real performance.
affiliates.step3: Adjust commission and visibility rules according to company policy.

hr.title: HR Guide
hr.description: Manage employees, attendance, leaves, and payroll from HR.
hr.step1: Choose the needed area such as attendance, leaves, or payroll from the menu.
hr.step2: Review the employee and date range before approving requests or deductions.
hr.step3: Use logs and reports when you need to audit a decision.

settings.title: Settings Guide
settings.description: Configure company, storefront, and channel settings before daily operation.
settings.step1: Start with general company settings because they affect multiple screens.
settings.step2: Review storefront and channel settings before selling or receiving messages.
settings.step3: Save changes and test the related screen to confirm the result.

tasks.title: Tasks Guide
tasks.description: Track team work, deadlines, and progress inside the workspace.
tasks.step1: Use status and priority to identify what needs urgent follow-up.
tasks.step2: Open a task to review the owner, comments, and attachments before updating it.
tasks.step3: Move tasks between statuses when progress changes so the team view stays accurate.

reports.title: Reports Guide
reports.description: Analyze performance with filters, metrics, and export when needed.
reports.step1: Choose the date range first so numbers are comparable.
reports.step2: Use filters to break down results by channel, product, or team.
reports.step3: Export or share the report after confirming the data is up to date.

support.title: Support Guide
support.description: Track support tickets, FAQs, and resolution status.
support.step1: Start with open or high-priority tickets.
support.step2: Review ticket history before replying or changing status.
support.step3: Use categories and FAQs to speed up future replies.
